DRC: Ebola-Affected Zones vs HNRP Coverage Map (August 12, 2026)

💡 Quick summary

OCHA published a reference map comparing Ebola-affected and at-risk zones against areas covered by the HNRP (Humanitarian National Response Plan) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of August 12, 2026.

📌 Key takeaways

  • The map visualizes the geographic overlap between Ebola-affected zones and HNRP response coverage areas in the DRC
  • Published by UN OCHA, the map is available as a downloadable PDF (4.52 MB) from ReliefWeb
  • Humanitarian mapping of disease-affected zones is critical for coordinating response efforts and identifying coverage gaps
  • The map serves as a decision-support tool for humanitarian organizations operating in the region
  • ReliefWeb continues to be a primary distribution platform for OCHA-produced crisis reference maps
